description: This script automates the process of mapping and updating details between purchase receipts and delivery notes, including handling return documents, within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: map_rows
methods.description: Updates the detail field of a document item to match a return document item based on their names.

methods.name: row_is_mappable
methods.description: Determines if two document rows are similar enough to be mapped based on item code, batch number, serial number, or rate.

methods.name: make_return_document_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of original documents to their return documents from the database.

methods.name: set_document_detail_in_return_document
methods.description: Maps each row of original documents to their return documents, updating details accordingly.
